title: creep recipe, version 1
description: A recipe is data, never code (ADR 0025). creep does not read this file: internal/recipe decodes a recipe strictly (unknown fields, trailing data, repeated keys and keys in another case refused) and checks the same limits, and its tests keep this schema in sync (TestSchemaMatchesRecipe). A recipe loads only when the model flags its vulnerable fixture and clears its safe one. Errors name the field, never quote a value.

id.description: The recipe's name: a-z, 0-9 and -, not starting with -.

class.description: The vulnerability class the recipe's hypotheses name: the reader's closed set.

applies_to.description: File extensions the recipe is for.

hint.description: Untrusted text shown only to the reader, redacted and escaped, as data in its HINT block; never to the planner. Printable ASCII lines, at most 8.

poc.description: Optional. A PoC template with closed parameters (verify.Request, ADR 0019) whose oracle proves the class; creep checks it with the same rules as a model's PoC.

signatures.description: Lexical signatures, as in the tripwire table: plain byte strings matched on a line.

code.description: A small program; its source_line holds a source and its sink_line a sink.
